# Most matches played in UEFA European Football Championships by a team
![Most matches played in UEFA European Football Championships by a team](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/images/record.jpg)
**Share**

[ Contact an Account Manager ](https://business.guinnessworldrecords.com/contact-us?source=Website-EN-B2B%20Form) Who
    Germany Where
     Germany (Stuttgart)  When
     05 July 2024 
The most matches played in UEFA European Football Championships by a team is 58, achieved by Germany (West Germany 1960–88) between 1960 and 2024.
Germany are three-time winners of the men's UEFA Euros: in 1972 (their competition debut), 1980 and 1996. Their match record stands at 30 wins (also a record), 14 draws and 14 losses.
Records change on a daily basis and are not immediately published online. For a full list of record titles, please use our Record Application Search. (You will need to register / login for access)
